findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_live_card, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: render_live_card, live_card_status · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: render_live_card, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_live_card, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: render_live_card, live_card_status · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: render_live_card, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
